intro: Put the steps and conditions in order for using an appliance safely. Read the French first; open the translation whenever you want to check your understanding.

piezas.titulo: Reading the vocabulary and the forms
texto: Put the steps and conditions in order for using an appliance safely. Separate the fact from its context: verb tenses, connectors and who says what show when and by whom each piece of information is given.
Watch out: the imperative gives direct instructions; « avant de » and « après avoir » order actions. In this passage, «voyant» means «indicator light».
